subtitle.en: Instead of an Island Snapshot, screenshots of a central lake and a swampy area that are still in progress.
subtitle.zh: 这次不发岛屿快照，改发一片位于中心的湖和一片沼泽区域的截图——两者都还在做。

blocks.en: It's been a long time since the last posting! Time flies.
blocks.zh: 距上次发帖已经很久了！时间过得真快。

blocks.en: Normally I would post an Island Snapshot, but the viewpoint we have been using for Island Snapshots is a little bit unfortunate lately, since the main thing taking up the view is the mountain, which is an area we haven't worked on modeling-wise lately. (It is a big area so we are going to do a concentrated push on it in a little bit, when some other things get locked down.)
blocks.zh: 通常我会发一张岛屿快照，但最近我们一直用来拍岛屿快照的那个视角有点不巧，因为占满画面的主要是那座山，而这一带我们最近在建模上一直没动。（这是个大区域，所以等别的一些东西定下来之后，我们很快会对它做一次集中的攻坚。）

blocks.en: So, here are some screenshots of other stuff we have been working on lately. Both areas are in progress and will look better than this in the final game!
blocks.zh: 所以，下面是最近我们在忙的其他一些东西的截图。这两个区域都还在做，在最终版游戏里会比现在好看！

blocks.en: A lake that's central to the island...
blocks.zh: 一片位于岛屿中心的湖……

blocks.en: A swampy area with light buildings and walkways. The vegetation you see here is temporary! But I am happy we are finally starting to work on this area; if you look at it in the trailer, for example, it's obviously very much more temporary.
blocks.zh: 一片沼泽区域，有轻巧的建筑和步道。你在这里看到的植被是临时的！但我很高兴我们终于开始做这个区域了；比如你在预告片里看它，明显要临时得多。
